nodes.label: piSignage Arbitrary File Download via Log Path Traversal (api/settings/log)
nodes.precondition: Remote network access and low-privilege authenticated user credentials for the piSignage player web application (version < 2.6.4) on a Raspberry Pi device.
nodes.postcondition: Download of arbitrary local files across the Raspberry Pi file system via the 'api/settings/log?file=../' parameter traversal, exposing sensitive configurations, source code, and stored system credentials.

nodes.label: RaspAP Misconfigured Web Console Command Execution (includes/webconsole.php)
nodes.precondition: Network access and authenticated user access to RaspAP (version 2.5) web application hosting 'includes/webconsole.php' on the Raspberry Pi.
nodes.postcondition: Unrestricted command execution on the underlying Raspberry Pi operating system, enabling arbitrary file uploads, shell code execution, and lateral compromise of system services.

nodes.label: Raspberry Pi OS Default Credentials Administrator Access
nodes.precondition: Network reachability (e.g., SSH, local login, or service console) to Raspberry Pi OS (version <= 5.10) where the factory default credentials for account 'pi' with password 'raspberry' remain unchanged.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker acquires administrator (sudo/root) privileges and unrestricted control over the Raspberry Pi operating system and resident applications.

nodes.label: Raspberry Pi Optical Power LED Acoustic Eavesdropping (Glowworm Attack)
nodes.precondition: Raspberry Pi 3 B+ or 4 B (firmware/hardware through 2021-08-09) directly powering external audio-output equipment (speakers) currently playing sound, with a remote attacker possessing direct optical line of sight to the device power LED using a telescope and electro-optical sensor.
nodes.postcondition: Non-invasive exfiltration and physical reconstruction of acoustic speech signals played through the speakers derived from optical power consumption fluctuations captured from the power LED.

nodes.label: Oculus Browser Arbitrary HTML UI Injection and Potential Code Execution
nodes.precondition: Target user browsing the web using Oculus Browser (versions 5.2.7 through 5.7.11) visits an attacker-controlled remote web page.
nodes.postcondition: Arbitrary HTML injected into the Oculus Browser user interface, facilitating UI spoofing, credential phishing, and potential code execution in the context of an unprivileged local user session.

nodes.label: Oculus Desktop OVRRedir.exe Privileged File Write Local Privilege Escalation
nodes.precondition: Unprivileged local process execution on a Windows host running Oculus Desktop (version < 1.44.0.32849) capable of creating file-system hard links to log files targeted by OVRRedir.exe.
nodes.postcondition: Arbitrary file write with the elevated permissions of the privileged OVRRedir.exe process, resulting in full local privilege escalation to Administrator or SYSTEM on Windows.

nodes.label: Oculus Desktop OVRServiceLauncher.exe Handle Exposure Local Privilege Escalation
nodes.precondition: Unprivileged local process running on a Windows host with Oculus Desktop (version > 1.39 and < 31.1.0.67.507) where OVRServiceLauncher.exe fails to restrict privileged process handle management.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker captures and utilizes an exposed privileged process handle, gaining full local privilege escalation to Administrator or SYSTEM permissions.

nodes.label: NVIDIA Jetson Linux IOMMU Configuration Error PCI Bus Memory Compromise
nodes.precondition: Unprivileged attacker with physical access to an NVIDIA Jetson development board running vulnerable Jetson Linux distributions with improper IOMMU configuration via the PCI bus.
nodes.postcondition: Direct read and write access across the entire system address space via the PCI bus, resulting in denial of service, host code execution, complete privilege escalation, total integrity/confidentiality failure, and lateral scope extension to adjacent system components.
